description: This Java source file defines the class DomPsiConverter, which converts an IntelliJ PSI XML file structure into a W3C DOM tree representation, including nested classes for DOM node types and utility methods for text range mapping.

classes.name: DomPsiConverter
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to convert PSI XML files to W3C DOM and to retrieve text ranges for DOM nodes. Contains nested classes for DOM node types and collections.

classes.name: DomNode
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing common DOM Node interface, representing a PSI XML element with parent/child relationships and text content.

classes.name: DomDocument
classes.description: Represents the entire XML document as a DOM Document, with methods to access root element and child nodes.

classes.name: DomElement
classes.description: Represents an XML element node, providing access to attributes and child elements.

classes.name: DomText
classes.description: Represents text nodes within the DOM, providing access to text content.

classes.name: DomComment
classes.description: Represents comment nodes within the DOM.

classes.name: DomAttr
classes.description: Represents attribute nodes, providing access to attribute name, value, and owner element.

classes.name: DomNodeList
classes.description: Implementation of NodeList for holding child nodes.

classes.name: DomNamedNodeMap
classes.description: Implementation of NamedNodeMap for element attributes.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an XmlFile to a W3C DOM Document, handling cancellation and errors.

methods.name: getTextRange
methods.description: Returns the TextRange for a given DOM Node, focusing on element name for element nodes.
